caption:
Intuit stock fell about 10.8% on Friday (Reuters, afternoon) after it agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for about $3.68 billion, under a third of the roughly $12 billion it paid in 2021, and cut its fiscal 2027 revenue growth forecast to 8-9% from 9-10%.
Credit Karma's growth outlook fell to 3-7% from 11-13%, on a day the S&P 500 lost 3.6% and closed in a correction.

The full why, with charts, lands Sunday for members → link in bio.

#Intuit #INTU #Mailchimp #stockmarket #softwarestocks
